entry.title: 9' x 12" King Noble Fir Garland with Warm White LED Lights (Plug Operated)
entry.summary:
Vendor: King of Christmas
Type: Garland
Price: 99.00

The great thing about adding more garlands to your holiday oasis? The versatile decorating possibilities that come with it. Whether you already have one of our signature King Noble Christmas Trees or not, the beautiful King Noble Garland offers the instant upgrade you need to enhance any holiday setting. 9 feet in length and 12” wide, this dense and expansive garland is sure to compliment your décor year after year. With a blend of realistic and classic needle tips, this garland radiates genuine Christmas tradition that will endure decades of memories! The King Noble Garland sits perfectly on your stair railing, fireplace mantel, doorway, or anywhere else you’d like to drape some elegant Christmas spirit this season.

Spruce up the ambiance in your home this season with the Cypress Spruce Garland. Inspired by our prestigious Cypress Spruce Tree, this garland will be hard not to notice. Designed with the same tasteful blend of realistic tips (PE) and classic tips (PVC) as the Cypress Spruce tree, resulting in an impressive and beautiful Christmas garland.

Appropriate for indoor and outdoor use. The flexible material makes it easy to wrap through a banister, hang around the fireplace, or around a door frame. Create a warm and elegant Christmas display right inside your home with the majestic and eye-catching Cypress Spruce garland.

Why settle for less this holiday season when you can celebrate in grand style. Add a breathtaking and elegant looking garland to your home decor when you choose the Royal Fir Garland to grace your home this holiday season.
